label: Remove Chroma Key
description: Remove a solid or vignetted background by keying on color (chrominance), not just brightness — robust to lighting gradients that trip up naive color-distance or AI cutout tools on flat backgrounds. 100% local, no AI model required.
card_desc: Key out a solid/gradient background by color. Great for flat studio or poster backgrounds where AI cutout models leave a fringe.

fields.label: Background color
fields.note: Auto-detect re-samples the dominant background color fresh from the current image every time you preview or generate — if you change the source image, it adapts automatically.

fields.label: Background color
fields.note: Hex color to key out — only used when Background color is set to Manual.

fields.label: Tolerance
fields.note: Chroma distance below which a pixel is treated as fully background. Raise if background fringes survive; lower if foreground gets eaten.

fields.label: Feather
fields.note: Extra chroma distance over which the edge fades in — wider values give a softer antialiased edge.

fields.label: Despeckle
fields.note: Drops isolated foreground specks smaller than this many pixels (0 disables despeckling).

fields.label: Choke (matte shrink)
fields.note: Erodes the edge inward by roughly this many pixels before smoothing — use if a colored halo survives despeckle/decontamination. 0 = off. Higher values can thin out fine detail like hair strands, so nudge up gradually (try 0.5-2 first).

fields.label: Clean edge fringing
fields.note: Removes residual background-colour spill from semi-transparent edge pixels, without touching the alpha shape. Also now includes spill suppression on fully-opaque edge pixels (e.g. green-screen light bounce onto hair).

fields.label: Edge smoothing
fields.note: Gaussian blur applied to the alpha channel for smoother edges.
